facts.en: Completed an economics bachelor degree at Fictional Finch College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构雀鸟学院取得经济学学士学位。

facts.en: A 2023 course exercise simulated a fictional portfolio using instructor-supplied historical prices.
facts.zh: 2023 年课程练习使用教师提供的历史价格模拟虚构投资组合。

facts.en: The simulation covered 2018 through 2022; it used no live money or client assets.
facts.zh: 模拟覆盖 2018 至 2022 年；未使用真实资金或客户资产。

facts.en: The course workbook showed an 8% cumulative simulated change before transaction costs under its stated assumptions; this was not an annualized or realized return.
facts.zh: 课程工作簿在所述假设下显示扣除交易成本前累计模拟变化为 8%；这不是年化或已实现收益。

facts.en: Worked with 2 classmates; personally checked missing price rows and wrote the assumptions note.
facts.zh: 与 2 名同学合作；个人负责检查缺失价格行并撰写假设说明。

facts.en: No investment recommendation, predictive performance or personal portfolio profit is claimed.
facts.zh: 不声称提供投资建议、预测表现或个人投资组合利润。

facts.en: Data reporting assistant at Fictional Amber Ledger, 2023-10 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-10 至 2026-08 在虚构琥珀账册机构任数据报表助理。

facts.en: Updated reference-data tables from approved files and logged missing fields for analyst review.
facts.zh: 依据获批文件更新参考数据表并记录缺失字段供分析员审核。

facts.en: Prepared weekly exception summaries without selecting investments or interpreting suitability.
facts.zh: 准备每周异常摘要，不选择投资或解释适当性。

facts.en: Helped standardize report filenames with a senior analyst in 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-03 与高级分析员共同规范报表文件名。

facts.en: In a 4-week check during 2025-04, 36 of 40 sampled files followed the naming rule; no prior comparable sample was retained.
facts.zh: 2025-04 的 4 周检查中，40 份抽样文件有 36 份遵循命名规则；未保留此前可比样本。

facts.en: Uses Excel pivot tables and basic SQL queries in a training database.
facts.zh: 使用 Excel 数据透视表，并在培训数据库中使用基础 SQL 查询。

facts.en: Drafted a live-dashboard proposal in 2026-02; it was not implemented by 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草实时仪表板提案；截至 2026-08 尚未实施。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Lantern Library during 2024-04 to 2024-10 on weekends alongside paid work.
facts.zh: 2024-04 至 2024-10 周末在虚构灯笼图书馆做志愿者，与有薪工作同期。

facts.en: Prepared a shelf-label inventory for that library; it was not market analysis.
facts.zh: 为该图书馆准备书架标签清单；并非市场分析。
爱好绘制虚构交通地图。

facts.en: A portfolio caption calls the simulated 8% a live trading return, contradicting the course record.
facts.zh: 作品集说明将模拟的 8% 称为实盘交易收益，与课程记录矛盾。

facts.en: No professional investment licence, trading execution or client advisory authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录专业投资执照、交易执行或客户咨询权限。
